output_boundary: Root retains complete eight-member analysis. A separately qualified L-only projection preserves all own successes/failures/unchanged/damage cases and full source indexes. Blind sessions receive no experiment outcome, chosen winner, root report or L history.
predeclared: All current400 first20, eight complete systems, official counts/quality separate from trajectory update utility; frozen initial-chain reference F1. Keep all strata/weightings, actual costs and own A/A. No stable benefit claim on20.
read_conditions: All eight independently FINALIZED with verified seals and one unique successful official complete score each, zero failed jobs, then exact root READ.
repairs_and_damage: Between complete systems, a whole answer is exact when intent is correct and official exact-entity FP=FN=0; empty correct entities count as correct. This association does not establish a within-trajectory or node causal effect. Separate source-verified role diagnostics are required to explain a mechanism.

resampling.unit: paired utterance; keep all recording variants together

stratum_join: Join only the exact20 sample IDs to their pre-existing Fold-A metadata and verify utterance identity against the pinned analysis roster. Retain only sample_id, utterance_id and stratum; no runtime target supply.
